rv.q: Even if you are not a Parrot Head, you will enjoy this show.
This show will take you far from your concerns and drop you back in Skokie heading to the parking garage with a giant smile on your face.
Escape to Margaritaville offers exactly that: a coastal reset button when the city insists on being chilly and unpredictable.
However, it’s the talented, enthusiastic cast, musicians and behind-the-scenes artisitic support that highly recommends this production.
JIMMY BUFFET'S ESCAPE TO MARGARITAVILLE definitely has its moments of intoxicating merriment.
Didier knows how to turn material that relies on easy tropes into engaging and solid entertainment.
Some audience members will find Jimmy Buffett's Escape to Margaritaville a little cringy and lacking story development.
Playful and fun, 'Escape to Margaritaville' is a jukebox musical which brings together Jimmy Buffett's songs in a lighthearted story about budding romances.
Escape to Margaritaville is approachable for all musical theatre fans who are looking for a lighter fare and a goofy, silly show.
